title: Plan: default-off async direct prefill overlap diagnostic for top768

candidate.goal: Start top768 direct hot-pool prefill asynchronously so it can overlap with gate prefill or other prompt-side cold work.

implementation_constraints: Do not change accepted default path unless GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_DIRECT_PREFILL_ASYNC=1 is set.
The async worker must complete or be safely joined before any direct hot-pool entry can be used for compute.
The diagnostic may run before compute integration; misses-before-ready must be counted rather than silently using unready entries.
All validation runs must use MemoryMax=16000000000 and MemorySwapMax=0.
If stdout/model output is generated, it must be checked for coherence; pure prefill diagnostics can use short prompt and stderr counters only.
measurement_required: wall time of combined short diagnostic
whether direct prefill overlaps gate prefill or remains serialized

acceptance_for_continuing_to_compute_des.ttft_bound: The measured added prompt/TTFT cost attributable to top768 direct prefill must be <=725.135454 ms, preferably with margin.
acceptance_for_continuing_to_compute_des.source_ready_bound: Most selected entries must be ready before decode; otherwise miss-before-ready penalty must be included in the next hard-bound.
acceptance_for_continuing_to_compute_des.stability: No OOM, no swap, no direct read/copy failures.

rejection_rule: If async direct prefill cannot hide at least 58.5% of the measured 1745.225 ms source cost under the 16GB cgroup, reject cpu_moe=41 + top768 as a 10 tok/s route before implementing batched/fused exact compute.
